question: A football match lasts two equal periods of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**45 minutes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A football match is divided into **two equal periods **called **halves.**
 
• Each half is of** 45 minutes duration,** making the total duration of the match **90 minutes.**
 
• There is a **15-minute break **between the two halves, called **halftime.**
 
• The halftime break is an opportunity for the players to **rest, rehydrate**, and **receive instructions** from their coaches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 40 minutes is the duration of each half in **college-level football** matches in the United States.
 
• 50 minutes is not a standard duration for a football match.
